ios.desc:
Six quick questions. One daily trivia challenge. Can you go 6/6?

QuizFox is a fast, fun daily trivia game built for quick rounds, streaks, and replayable quiz challenges.

Test your knowledge across a wide range of categories, including history, science, sports, geography, entertainment, food, culture, and more. Improve your accuracy, build your streak, beat your best score, and progress through QuizFox Quest.

Whether you have one minute or want to play again and again, QuizFox makes trivia quick, challenging, and easy to jump into.

Why you’ll love QuizFox:

• Play a new Daily Challenge every day
• Answer quick 6-question trivia rounds
• Try multiple game modes: Daily, Blitz, Survival, and Classic
• Track your accuracy, streaks, progress, and scores
• Learn something new with every question
• Explore trivia categories based on your interests
• Build your streak and advance through QuizFox Quest
• Play fast rounds in under a minute

How it works:

1. Pick a mode or start the Daily Challenge
2. Answer a short set of trivia questions
3. See your score instantly
4. Play again to beat your score and improve your streak

It’s simple, fast, and harder than it looks.

Can you get a perfect score?

Most players miss at least one.

New trivia content and themed packs keep the challenge fresh, including limited-time events like Mother’s Day trivia and other seasonal quiz packs.

If you like daily trivia, quiz games, brain games, knowledge challenges, quick rounds, score chasing, and streaks, QuizFox is built for you.

Play today’s Daily Challenge and start your QuizFox Quest.

quotes.text:
Alright, I am building QuizFox, a small daily trivia app for iOS: 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quizfox-daily-trivia-game/id6761871952

I’ve always liked trivia / Jeopardy-style games and learning, so this started as a fun side project to see how quickly I could build and ship something “real” using AI-assisted development (I got my niece and nephews in there trying it out, so a success there for them to see that they can build the next new awesome app themselves!).

AI dev is definitely hit or miss on development, but I am surprised at how well AI is doing some app dev tasks (using frameworks it does exceedingly well, not surprising!), and also some misses (trivia writing it does oddly well, but verifiability is imperfect, I had some issues early on with hallucination to fix, but pretty good now!).

Would love feedback, especially on the onboarding, obvious gotchas, question quality, and the app overall, I am using it to learn a lot quickly!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (May 2026)
